# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 113 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 113 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_113_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 10, Chapter 3

**1** "Do you know these things now?" he asked me. "I know them, Lord," I replied. "I know all these things from the words I have heard from you." **2** "But there are other things beyond these that you need," he said. "For I have not declared to you all the things you must do. But now, listen carefully. **3** Fulfill and keep the things that have been commanded to you. And those things you have heard from the church — obey them. **4** And tell those who are leaders of the church that they may direct their steps in righteousness; so that they may attain all righteousness and be cleansed and washed through the seal of the Son of God. **5** For this seal is the truth; and those who bear it shall enter the kingdom of God. **6** Do not be idle in the things of the Lord. **7** For you, Hermas — you shall tell all these words to the elders of the church, and let this be proclaimed throughout the whole world. **8** Tell all the leaders of the church that they may direct their steps with all righteousness, **9** that salvation and forgiveness of sins may be theirs through the name of the Son of God, and through his great and glorious name they shall be made glorious." **10** And so the shepherd departed from me, and after him, the Glorious One.

---

*LOGOS: "direct their steps in righteousness" (v. 4, 8) — the double commission to church leaders is the Shepherd's final public mandate. The seal = truth (v. 5) is its most compressed definition.*
